'''''LMS Journal of Computation and Mathematics''''' was a [[peer-reviewed]] online [[mathematics journal]] covering computational aspects of mathematics published by the [[London Mathematical Society]].<ref name=lms>{{cite web|url=https://www.lms.ac.uk/publications/journals |title=Journals |work=LMS Publications |publisher=[[London Mathematical Society]]| access-date=2020-03-14}}</ref>  The journal published its first article in 1998 and ceased operation in 2017.  An [[open access]] archive of the journal is maintained by [[Cambridge University Press]].<ref name=cup>{{cite web|url=https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/lms-journal-of-computation-and-mathematics/all-issues| title=LMS Journal of Computation and Mathematics: All issues |publisher=[[Cambridge University Press]] |access-date=2020-03-14}}</ref>

==Abstracting and indexing==
The journal is abstracted and indexed in [[MathSciNet]],<ref name=MathSciNet>{{cite web |url=https://mathscinet.ams.org/mathscinet/search/mathscinet/search/journal/profile?groupId=4170 |title=LMS Journal of Computation and Mathematics |publisher=[[American Mathematical Society]] |work=[[MathSciNet]] |access-date=2020-03-14}}</ref> [[Scopus]],<ref name=Scopus>{{cite web |url=https://www.scopus.com/sourceid/19900192440 |title=Source details: LMS Journal of Computation and Mathematics |publisher=[[Elsevier]] |work=Scopus Preview |accessdate=2020-03-14}}</ref> and [[Zentralblatt MATH]].<ref name=MATH>{{cite web |url=http://www.zentralblatt-math.org/serials/ |title=Serials Database |publisher=[[Springer Science+Business Media]] |work=[[Zentralblatt MATH]] |accessdate=2020-03-14}}</ref>
